steps.summary: On RD-1017 I clicked "Mark Ready" and the app refused with the alert, quoted verbatim: "Ticket is not ready Part \"fwrd59-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A\" has no supplier Part \"fwrd59-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B\" has no supplier" — i.e. the precondition is that every part must have a Supplier (the "Not recorded" customer was not required). I satisfied it by opening each part's Edit dialog (fields: Part name *, Cost *, Markup % *, Quantity, Supplier) and setting Supplier = "Bench Supplies Co" on both Part A and Part B, then clicked "Mark Ready" again; the action succeeded and the page now shows Status: Ready (the page's status action buttons are now Mark Draft, Mark Closed and Archive ticket, with Mark Ready gone). Parts prices were unchanged by the supplier edit: Part A $150.00 / 25% / $187.50, Part B $200.00 / 25% / $250.00, total $437.50.
